limits: Browser automation and CDP touch events are not physical-device touch, Safari/WKWebView, LiDAR, VoiceOver or performance acceptance.
No hosted sign-in, remote app refresh, live integration, signing, distribution or native build performed by this worker.

This corrects immediate drawing interactions; companion parity and usability superiority remain unaccepted. Rectangle rooms, multi-selection, drag openings and broader snapping are separate unfinished work.
Wall crossings and T-junctions are not automatically stitched. Shared endpoints connect only through exact corner identities.

Unfinished drawing is explicit local state until Finish. Parent guard covers internal workspace actions; browser unload warns. External OS SPA navigation can still unmount it. Only accepted transactions participate in durable recovery.
